info.title: Calibrate Public API
info.description: Programmatic API for CI/automation. Pass your key in the `X-API-Key` header.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable agent name, unique within the workspace

type.title: Type
type.description: `agent` applies managed defaults deep-merged under any supplied `config`; `connection` stores the config you supply as-is (must eventually contain `agent_url`)

config.title: Config
config.description: Behavioral config (system_prompt, llm, stt, tts, settings, …). Deep-merged over defaults for `type=agent`; stored as-is for `type=connection`. Omit for `type=agent` to use defaults

uuid.title: Uuid
uuid.description: ID of the newly created agent

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: Test run job ID. Poll for status and results

status.description: Current status of the test run: `queued` or `in_progress`

name.title: Name
name.description: New agent name. Omit to leave the name unchanged

config.title: Config
config.description: Replacement config, stored as-is (no deep-merge on update). Changing `agent_url` or `agent_headers` resets all connection/benchmark verification flags. Omit to leave config unchanged

connection_verified.title: Connection Verified
connection_verified.description: Directly set the `connection_verified` flag inside config. Omit to leave it untouched

benchmark_models_verified.title: Benchmark Models Verified
benchmark_models_verified.description: Directly set the per-model benchmark verification map inside config. Omit to leave it untouched

agent_names.title: Agent Names
agent_names.description: Agents to run. Omit to run every agent in your workspace

agent_uuid.title: Agent Uuid
agent_uuid.description: ID of the agent that was run

task_id.title: Task Id
task_id.description: Test run job ID. Poll for status and results

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Agents that were skipped instead of failing the batch

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this agent was not run

name.title: Name
name.description: Test name, unique within the batch

conversation_history.title: Conversation History
conversation_history.description: Ordered messages ending at the user turn the agent should answer (must be non-empty)

type.title: Type
type.description: Test kind applied to every item in the batch

tests.title: Tests
tests.description: Test items to create (non-empty, max 500 per request, names unique within the batch)

agent_uuids.title: Agent Uuids
agent_uuids.description: Agents (IDs) to link every created test to. Omit to link none

language.title: Language
language.description: Language written to each test's `config.settings.language`. Omit to leave unset

uuids.title: Uuids
uuids.description: IDs of the created tests, in request order

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Non-fatal issues (e.g. agents some tests couldn't link to). Null when there were none

role.title: Role
role.description: Message author role in the conversation history

content.title: Content
content.description: Message text. Omit for assistant messages that only carry `tool_calls`

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: Tool calls issued by the assistant. Omit for plain text turns

tool_call_id.title: Tool Call Id
tool_call_id.description: ID of the tool call this message responds to. **Required for `role=tool`**

name.title: Name
name.description: Tool name for `role=tool` messages. Omit otherwise

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: Name of the tool the agent is expected to call

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Expected argument values, diffed against the generated call. Omit to expect no arguments

accept_any_arguments.title: Accept Any Arguments
accept_any_arguments.description: When `true`, only the tool name must match and `arguments` is ignored

evaluator_uuid.title: Evaluator Uuid
evaluator_uuid.description: ID of the evaluator that produced this verdict; null for legacy runs or when the evaluator can't be resolved from the snapshot

match.title: Match
match.description: Binary evaluator pass/fail. **Set only for binary evaluators** (else null; `score` is set instead)

score.title: Score
score.description: Rating evaluator numeric score. **Set only for rating evaluators** (else null; `match` is set instead)

value_name.title: Value Name
value_name.description: Human-readable label for `match`/`score` resolved against the run's rubric. Falls back to `Correct`/`Wrong` (binary) or the stringified score (rating) when the snapshot lacks named scale entries

variable_values.title: Variable Values
variable_values.description: `{{var}}` substitutions used for this evaluator on this test case, frozen at submission time; null when none

names.title: Names
names.description: Agent names to resolve to IDs

resolved.title: Resolved
resolved.description: Map of name to agent ID for each name that matched

not_found.title: Not Found
not_found.description: Names with no matching agent in your workspace

test_uuids.title: Test Uuids
test_uuids.description: Tests to run. Omit to run all tests linked to the agent

test_case_id.title: Test Case Id
test_case_id.description: Identifier of the test case within the run

name.title: Name
name.description: Test name; present during in-progress and done states

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether the case passed. Present only when done

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: LLM judge reasoning or deterministic tool-call diff; null for passing tool-call tests

output.description: The agent's output for this case. Present only when done

test_case.title: Test Case
test_case.description: The input test case definition. Present only when done

judge_results.title: Judge Results
judge_results.description: Per-evaluator verdicts for response/conversation tests; null for tool-call tests or in-progress rows

latency_ms.title: Latency Ms
latency_ms.description: Response-generation latency in ms for the agent under test (not the judge). Present only for live runs; null for in-progress and eval-only runs. Float, since external agents may self-report a fractional value

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Per-case cost in USD, lifted from calibrate's nested `output.cost`. Null when the provider/agent reports none (e.g. `--provider openai`)

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable test name, unique within the workspace

type.title: Type
type.description: Test kind (immutable after creation): `response` judges the generated reply, `tool_call` diffs generated tool calls, `conversation` judges the full conversation

config.title: Config
config.description: Calibrate test config (`history`, `evaluation`, optional `settings`). Omit to create an empty shell to fill in later

evaluators.title: Evaluators
evaluators.description: Evaluators to link. **Required (>=1) for `type=conversation`** (no fallback judge). Omit for `response`/`tool_call` to link none

uuid.title: Uuid
uuid.description: ID of the newly created test

response.title: Response
response.description: The agent's generated reply; null for tool-call-only cases

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: Tool calls the agent generated; null when it made none

total_tests.title: Total Tests
total_tests.description: Total number of test cases; null until known

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Number of test cases that passed; null until done

failed.title: Failed
failed.description: Number of test cases that failed; null until done

latency_ms.title: Latency Ms
latency_ms.description: Aggregated response latency `{p50, p95, p99, count}` (ms; `p50` ≈ the old mean). Null for eval-only runs

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Aggregated cost `{mean, min, max, count}` (USD). Null when no case reported a cost (e.g. openai provider)

total_tokens.title: Total Tokens
total_tokens.description: Aggregated token usage `{mean, min, max, count}` (values are `Any` — `mean` may be fractional). Null when no case reported usage

evaluators.title: Evaluators
evaluators.description: Top-level evaluator block (name/description/output_type/rubric) shared across every `judge_results` row, which references back via `evaluator_uuid` so the rubric isn't duplicated per case

results_s3_prefix.title: Results S3 Prefix
results_s3_prefix.description: S3 key prefix for the raw result artifacts; null until uploaded

is_public.title: Is Public
is_public.description: Whether the run is shared publicly

share_token.title: Share Token
share_token.description: Public share token; null unless the run is public

name.title: Name
name.description: New test name. Omit to leave unchanged

type.title: Type
type.description: Test type. Immutable — may only echo the existing value; a different value is rejected (400). Omit to leave unchanged

config.title: Config
config.description: Replacement calibrate config. Omit to leave unchanged

evaluators.title: Evaluators
evaluators.description: Replacement evaluator links (replaces the existing set). Omit to leave links unchanged; an empty list clears them (**rejected for `conversation` tests**)

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: Name of the tool the agent called

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Arguments the agent passed to the tool; null if none

output.title: Output
output.description: Tool execution result (any JSON value). Present only for agent-connection tests where the external agent runs the tool and echoes its return value; null for calibrate-agent mode (tools are declared, never executed) or agents that don't echo it

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the agent was created (ISO 8601 UTC)

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the agent was last updated (ISO 8601 UTC)

evaluator_uuid.title: Evaluator Uuid
evaluator_uuid.description: Evaluator to attach to the test

variable_values.title: Variable Values
variable_values.description: Values for the evaluator's `{{placeholder}}` variables, pinned per-test on the pivot. Omit to inherit the evaluator version's defaults

evaluators.title: Evaluators
evaluators.description: Linked evaluators, resolved to their current live version at read time
